thread:
Maya (CS): FYI - Neptune Labs flagged a month-end reconciliation mismatch. Invoice total is ~12,345 tokens higher than their dashboard. They attached invoice and dashboard screenshots.
Omar: Can you drop account id + invoice number?
Maya (CS): acct_neptune (acct_0n3ptun3), invoice INV-2026-03-31-789. Screenshot: https://redwood.s3/nyc/neptune/invoice-march.png and dashboard (sensitive view) https://redwood.s3/nyc/neptune/dashboard-march.png
Priya (Billing): Looking at INV-2026-03-31-789 — billing run id br-20260331-14 shows an extra line: "burst-reserve-tokens" 12,345 tokens, $0.62. That line isn't present in the CS dashboard export. Did metering include a backfill?
Daniel (Finance): Did the customer have any plan tier change around cutoff? Tier on invoice is Standard Pro. dashboard shows Standard. Not a tier bump.
metering-bot: [automated] Metering pipeline: backfill_job finished at 2026-03-31T00:07:12Z (job id bf-20260331-007). Processed 8 accounts, duplicates detected: 1 account with duplicate raw_request_id entries.
Omar: That looks like our earlier backfill duplication bug (race + retry idempotency). Maya, can you ask Neptune if they re-sent any bulk embedding jobs around ~23:58-00:05 UTC?
Maya (CS): Asking now. Neptune says they kicked an export & embed job at 2026-03-30T23:58:45Z and saw retries from their side but assumed idempotent. They attached job id: neptune-job-8821.
Priya (Billing): Querying metering events for acct_0n3ptun3. Run this to repro:

```
SELECT raw_request_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM meter_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_0n3ptun3'
  AND timestamp >= '2026-03-30T23:55:00Z' AND timestamp < '2026-03-31T00:10:00Z'
GROUP BY raw_request_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```

Priya (Billing): Running locally — returns raw_request_id rreq_9ff... with COUNT=2 and tokens=12,345 (same delta). So duplicate raw_request_id shows up in meter_events. Looks like the dedupe step in ingestion didn't remove the retry duplicate because backfill job bypassed the idempotency layer.
Omar: That explains why dashboard (which uses deduped aggregated view built after dedupe) didn't show the second record, but invoice (which pulled from raw billing-run snapshot that included backfill records) captured it. Slight mismatch in which table each system reads from.
Daniel (Finance): Proposed mitigation: 1) void invoice line and issue credit of $0.62, 2) re-run billing-run for INV-2026-03-31-789 with dedupe applied or mark the duplicate as excluded from final bill, 3) follow-up postmortem and automation to prevent backfill bypassing dedupe. Approve?
Priya (Billing): I can create adjustment ADJ-NEP-20260331 and issue negative line to offset 12,345 tokens. Also will annotate invoice metadata linking to backfill job bf-20260331-007. Will wait for confirmation from CS/Customer.
Maya (CS): Neptune confirms they did not want to be charged for duplicate retry. They requested a credit and an explanation.
Omar: Root cause: backfill job processed raw events directly into billing-snapshot table without running dedupe middleware. Short-term fix: mark bf-20260331-007 as processed and excluded, add invoice adjustment. Long-term: enforce dedupe in backfill path + add a pre-bill sanity check comparing billing-run snapshot to deduped aggregate.
Priya (Billing): Adjustment created ADJ-NEP-20260331-1, pending approvals. I'll fast-track and CC legal if necessary. Expected customer-facing credit: $0.62.
Daniel (Finance): I'll mark the invoice as adjusted in the ledger and confirm once journal entry posted.
Maya (CS): I'll send Neptune the summary: cause, action taken, and ETA.
Omar: For internal follow-up - assign postmortem to eng-metering team, tag: backfill-dedupe-bypass. Also add a test in CI that simulates backfill + retry and asserts dedupe still holds.
Priya (Billing): After adjustment posted, please confirm this thread so I can close the billing ticket.
Maya (CS): Will confirm once invoice credit visible to Neptune.
Omar: Thanks team. Quick checklist left: (1) Confirm credit posted, (2) patch backfill idempotency path, (3) add pre-bill sanity diff job, (4) postmortem + timeline.
Maya (CS): Neptune confirmed credit reflected on their portal at 2026-04-02T10:12Z. Closing from CS side. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Billing): Adjustment posted and ledger entry done. Closing billing ticket.
Omar: Created GH issue redwood/infra#4621 for backfill dedupe enforcement and assigned to eng-metering.
Daniel (Finance): Closing reconciliation entry after verifying ledger. Thanks all.
Maya (CS): Great, will follow up PM to Neptune with the postmortem summary once eng posts it. :+1:
